description: Give a place name in Japanese or English (e.g. 帯広, Obihiro, 京都市 の基準局, 札幌の警報). Returns in one call: the municipality (5-digit code), JMA warnings in force, the nearest free RTK base station (km, mountpoint, host) and the page URLs. No key. Use this first when a user asks about a Japanese place; call here/rtk_bases_near for detail.

q.description: place name, Japanese or English. Extra words like 基準局/警報/near are fine
